descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The open road, from the driver's seat - in Chicago.

CHICAGO'S EXPRESSWAYS
A 38-mile loop of real Chicago expressway built from real map data: the Eisenhower east past the United Center into the Jane Byrne Interchange right under the Willis Tower, the Kennedy north-west past the skyline and Wrigleyville out to O'Hare, then the Tri-State Tollway south along the airport cargo ramps back to Hillside. Real ramps, real overpasses, the Loop's towers and Lake Michigan on the horizon.

A SHOW TRUCK TO CALL HOME
Walnut dash, cognac tufting, fourteen working gauges and a starlight headliner. Grip the wheel with your own hands, pull the air horn, set the parking brake - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 10-SPEED
Pick AUTOMATIC and just drive, or switch to MANUAL and float a 10-speed through the H-pattern with a LO/HI range. Match the revs and it drops in. Miss it and it grinds.

HAUL REAL CHICAGO LOADS
Six depots in real Chicago places - Cicero, Fulton Market, Jefferson Park, O'Hare Cargo, Elmhurst and Hillside. Back under your trailer, take the load from dispatch and deliver it through Chicago traffic.

DAY AND NIGHT
Drive at noon or after dark with the skyline lit up and the Hancock antennas blinking over the lake. Night runs pay extra.

ON THE RADIO
A real dispatcher and five truckers on the CB with Chicago road talk.

THE SLEEPER
Leave the seat, walk back into the sleeper and sleep through to morning.

Plus 17 achievements, 9 paints, a live map and Chicago flags at every yard.
